part.text: Both PEs share A_anchor.key=`player_api_id`, so I can JOIN them. Executing the query per the evidence formula.

input.sql:
SELECT p.player_name AS name, SUM(pa.heading_accuracy) * 1.0 / COUNT(p.player_fifa_api_id) AS avg_heading_accuracy
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.height > 180
GROUP BY p.player_api_id
ORDER BY avg_heading_accuracy DESC
LIMIT 10;
